title: Graduated Reinstatement Fees for Repeat Parking License Suspensions
content:
Notes to the Parking License collections schedule: a license restored again within three years pays a graduated fee for the restoration.

## Note

When two or more reinstatement fees were billed on the license in the 36 months before the handling date, the graduated fee is $75.00; when exactly one reinstatement fee was billed in those months, the graduated fee is $50.00; in every other case the graduated fee is the product's reinstatement fee. The reinstatement fee billed with the restoration starts from the graduated fee.

## Graduated fee by prior restorations

| Reinstatement fees already billed on the license in the 36 months before the handling date | Graduated fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | $75.00 (third restoration or later) |
| exactly one | $50.00 (second restoration) |
| none | the product's reinstatement fee |

## Illustrations (hypothetical histories)

- Earlier reinstatement fees 8 and 20 months before the handling date: $75.00.
- One earlier reinstatement fee 35 months before: $50.00.
- One earlier reinstatement fee 40 months before and none since: outside the 36 months, so the product's reinstatement fee.
